traits: Headlines rise a short way and settle without a bounce, so nothing overshoots its mark.
Every scene rests for at least a second and a half before anything changes: the frame is still more often than it moves.
Scenes dissolve, push or dip into the next one; a hard cut is kept for the opening.
A group of items arrives in a slow cascade, about seven hundredths of a second apart, and finishes within a second.

notLike.line: premium also moves slowly, but its headlines come in out of blur and its springs give a faint bounce; calm never blurs and never bounces.
proof is as still as calm but cuts hard between every scene; calm lets each scene dissolve or slide into the next.

nativeMoves.move: The push cut: the next scene slides in carrying the previous one out, used when two scenes are about the same subject.
nativeMoves.transfer: A cooking class film where each recipe step pushes in from the side, so the steps read as one continuing hand.

nativeMoves.move: A single zoom-through held back for the turn of the film, with everything before it quiet.
nativeMoves.transfer: An onboarding film that stays still until the moment the product first shows the viewer their own data, and zooms through only there.

nativeMoves.move: A colour dip as the closing cut: the last scene fades into a flat brand colour rather than to black.
nativeMoves.transfer: A quarterly letter to members that ends on a dip to the canvas colour, then the sign-off line.

pitfalls.mistake: Packing in more than about five arrivals every ten seconds.
pitfalls.mechanism: The 1.6 second hold floor collapses and the slow eases read as lag, so the frame is always mid-move and never rests.
pitfalls.fix: Cut beats until each scene carries one idea, or move to kinetic if the content really is dense.

pitfalls.mistake: Using slam, punch or drop entrances on a calm style.
pitfalls.mechanism: A hard-edged entrance has no soft landing to meet the 0.05 overshoot ceiling, so it looks clipped against the dissolves around it.
pitfalls.fix: Keep to rise, fade, count and pop; ask for emphasis from the colour or the hold, not the entrance.

pitfalls.mistake: Hard-cutting every scene to save time.
pitfalls.mechanism: Calm leans on the dissolve to carry one scene into the next; without it, scenes sit side by side as separate slides.
pitfalls.fix: Leave topic as crossfade and related as push, or choose proof if the film should cut.

free: Which scenes take the push and which the crossfade, within the topic and related roles.
Scene length, from the 1.6 second hold floor upward.
A fade in place of a rise for a headline that should arrive quieter.
Where the one zoom-through lands, and the colour of the closing dip (any palette role).
invariants: A hold floor of 1.6 seconds and no more than five arrivals per ten seconds.
A hard cut only as the opening.
